sn34.5:1.4: idha bhikkhave, ekacco jhāyī samādhismiṃ samādhikusalo hoti, na samādhismiṃ ārammaṇakusalo.
sn34.5:1.5: idha pana bhikkhave, ekacco jhāyī samādhismiṃ ārammaṇakusalo hoti, na samādhismiṃ samādhikusalo.
sn34.5:1.6: idha pana bhikkhave, ekacco jhāyī neva samādhismiṃ samādhikusalo hoti, na samādhismiṃ ārammaṇakusalo.
sn34.5:1.7: idha pana bhikkhave, ekacco jhāyī samādhismiṃ samādhikusalo ca hoti, samādhismiṃ ārammaṇakusalo ca.
sn34.5:1.8: tatra bhikkhave, yvāyaṃ jhāyī samādhismiṃ samādhikusalo ca samādhismiṃ ārammaṇakusalo ca ayaṃ imesaṃ catunnaṃ jhāyīnaṃ aggo ca seṭṭho ca mokkho ca uttamo ca pavaro ca.
sn34.5:1.9: seyyathāpi bhikkhave, gavā khīraṃ, khīramhā dadhi, dadhimhā …pe…
